short: Quoting a price to which tax is added at billing.
seoTitle: Tax Exclusive Pricing — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Tax exclusive pricing quotes the base price and adds GST as a separate line at billing, so the customer pays more than the listed figure.
definition: Tax exclusive pricing quotes the base price and adds GST as a separate line at billing, so the customer pays more than the listed figure. It is the norm in B2B trade, wholesale and professional services.
bodyHtml:
Why Tax Exclusive Pricing matters

Business customers prefer exclusive quotes because they reclaim the tax as credit and compare suppliers on the base price. Quoting exclusive to a consumer, though, usually reads as a hidden charge.

Tax Exclusive Pricing formula

Invoice total = Base price + (Base price × GST rate ÷ 100)

The base price is the taxable value reported in your returns.

How Tax Exclusive Pricing works in practice

Say which basis a quotation uses, in words, on the document. Most disputes over quotations come down to one side reading a number as inclusive and the other as exclusive.

faq.question: Which is better for my business?
faq.answer: Consumer-facing sales usually work better inclusive; B2B quotes are conventionally exclusive.

faq.question: Do I have to state the basis on a quotation?
faq.answer: It is not always mandatory, but stating it prevents the most common billing dispute there is.
